description: 8-frame seamless diagonal rain texture for layering over dark cinematic night scenes.
generation_prompt: Starting state: many narrow rain streaks spaced across the full tile, all leaning slightly from upper-left to lower-right. Action: the rain falls steadily downward and diagonally to the lower-right, with a gentle stagger so individual streaks enter from the top as others leave the bottom; keep the density and direction consistent. Ending: return to the same rain arrangement and spacing as the opening frame for a seamless loop. Keep the camera fixed, no splash, no wind gust, no new objects, crisp pixel clusters.
